pairs: Hæc dicit Dominus christo meo Cyro,
Thus says the Lord to my anointed Cyrus,
ut subjiciam ante faciem ejus gentes,
so that I may subjugate the nations before his face,
and I may turn the backs of kings,
and I may open the doors before him,
and so that the gates will not be shut.
And I will humble the glorious ones of the earth.
I will shatter the gates of brass,
and I will break apart the bars of iron.
And I will give you hidden treasures
and the knowledge of secret things,
so that you may know that I am the Lord,
For the sake of Jacob, my servant,
electum meum; et vocavi te nomine tuo:
my elect, I have even called you by your name.
and you have not known me.
and there is no one else.
There is no god beside me.
and you have not known me.
ut sciant hi qui ab ortu solis
So may those who are from the rising of the sun,
and those who are from its setting,
know that there is no one beside me.
I form the light and create the darkness.
I make peace and create disaster.
and let the clouds rain down upon the just!
Let the earth open and spring forth a savior!
And let justice rise up at once!
Woe to him who contradicts his Maker,
a mere shard from an earthen vessel!
Numquid dicet lutum figulo suo: Quid facis,
Should the clay say to the potter, “What are you making?”
et opus tuum absque manibus est?
or, “Your work is not made by your hands?”
Woe to him who says to his father,
Would you question me about the future,
et super opus manuum mearum mandate mihi.
and command me concerning the work of my hands?
et hominem super eam creavi ego:
and I created man upon it.
My hand stretched out the heavens,
and I have commanded all their hosts.
I have raised him up unto justice,
and I will direct all his ways.
He himself will build my city and release my captives,
but not for ransom or gifts,
non in pretio neque in muneribus,
et negotiatio Æthiopiæ, et Sabaim viri sublimes ad te transibunt,
and the business dealings of Ethiopia, and of the Sabeans,
will pass to you and will be yours.
They will travel, bound in irons.
teque deprecabuntur. Tantum in te est Deus,
And they will adore you and petition you: “In you alone is God,
et non est absque te deus.
and there is no God apart from you.
Truly, you are a hidden God,
simul abierunt in confusionem fabricatores errorum.
These fabricators of errors have departed together into confusion!
Israël salvatus est in Domino salute æterna;
Israel is saved in the Lord by an eternal salvation.
et non erubescetis usque in sæculum sæculi.
and you will not be ashamed, even forever and ever.
Quia hæc dicit Dominus creans cælos,
God himself who formed the earth and made it,
He did not create it to no purpose.
He formed it so that it would be inhabited.
I have not spoken in secret,
in a dark place of the earth.
I have not said to the offspring of Jacob,
I am the Lord, who speaks justice,
et accedite simul qui salvati estis ex gentibus:
and draw near together, you who have been saved among the Gentiles.
nescierunt qui levant lignum sculpturæ suæ,
They lack knowledge, who lift up the wood of their sculpture,
and who petition a god unable to save.
et consiliamini simul. Quis auditum fecit hoc ab initio,
and consult together. Who has caused this to be heard from the beginning,
ex tunc prædixit illud? numquid non ego Dominus,
and who has foretold it from that time? Is it not I,
et non est ultra deus absque me?
the Lord? And is there some other god beside me?
Deus justus, et salvans non est præter me.
I am a just God who saves, and there is no one except me.
egredietur de ore meo justitiæ verbum, et non revertetur:
The Word of justice will proceed from my mouth,
quia mihi curvabitur omne genu, et jurabit omnis lingua.
and it will not turn back.
Ergo in Domino, dicet, meæ sunt justitiæ et imperium;
For every knee shall bend to me,
ad eum venient, et confundentur omnes qui repugnant ei.
and every tongue shall swear it.
Therefore, he will say, “In the Lord are my justices and my dominion.”
They will go to him. And all who fight against him will be confounded.
In the Lord, all the offspring of Israel will be justified and praised.
